slice: subscription lifecycle, one-shot waits, declarative conditions, plugin-owned time source and notification routing
purpose: Add the H2b event layer offline: CAS subscription lifecycle with activation-generation semantics, one-shot zero-model waits, declarative bounded conditions, a plugin-owned declarative SchedulePort with a cooperative zero-model tick, and a destination-restricted notification router with durable intent identity.

implementation.rules: EventRuleStore persists declarative rules and derived state as atomic JSON under the control dir (subscriptions/deliveries/ack remain authoritative in the control DB): conditions only eq/in/changed/gt/gte/lt/lte/exists, <=8 predicates, filterable primitives, in<=16; callbacks/JS/SQL/regex are not expressible; bounded retention of lastSeen, time/observation watermarks, wait outcomes and notification intents.
implementation.lifecycle: SubscriptionLifecycleService: subscribe/update/pause/resume/unsubscribe/list/status with expectedRevision CAS; declarative-only updates bump a condition revision and close the old activation generation via pause+resume while cancelling old pending deliveries; a paused/resumed subscription never gets a second hit for the same event; withDeclarativeCondition gates continuation so unmatched events only store a zero-model background reference and ack; OnceWaitService holds one-shot waits without a worker slot or model call and still revalidates Assignment/Goal/pause/budget before dispatch.
implementation.timeSource: SchedulePort plus RuleBasedSchedulePort (plugin rules, not DSH dsh-schedule); trigger identity = subscription + ruleRevision(condition revision) + canonical scheduled occurrence; duplicate ticks/schedules execute once; latest-only merges missed occurrences, skip/grace drops expired ones with an explicit gap; fresh/restart establish a baseline and never replay history; clock backstop/timezone/rule changes record gaps; once triggers once and never on restart; cancel/pause/unsubscribe never revive; injected read-only ObservationPort polls boundedly (failure is a gap, not no-change); TimeSourcePump is a cooperative tick with its own timer, no operation slot, no model call, pause gate, in-flight tick merge and drain on close; H2B_EVENT_TYPES = time.occurred/observation.changed.
implementation.notifications: NotificationRouter: destinations only from registered rules (association never broadcasts); each destination gets a restricted view (metadata plus explicit allowedFields and digest); durable intent identity dedupes across restart/reconnect; unknown/failed are never auto-resent (read-only reconcile only); causation depth (default 8) and loop blocking; fan-out and pending intents bounded with explicit deferred; zero model calls.
